name: system-error-handling-strategy
description: System-level error-handling strategy: error classification (programmer / validation / domain-rejection / transient-dependency / resource-exhaustion / poison-data / external-contract / unknown), per-class strategy (fail-fast / retry with budget / compensate / circuit-break / shed-load / dead-letter / escalate), propagation + translation across layers + contexts, idempotency + retry safety, partial-failure + timeout budgets, observability + alerting, user-facing vs operator-facing errors, incident-response coupling. Distinct from UX error-handling-design. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
